what.text: This page follows refugees from the Niger in all host countries combined, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 85591 refugees from the Niger.
Mali hosts the largest share, 80.6%, followed by Nigeria, Benin and Chad.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict with the Islamic State group in the Niger from 2015 to 2025.
It also records armed conflict over the government of the Niger in several periods, most recently with JNIM from 2021 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 1992 at 22006 refugees, and the figure fell to a low in 1998.
It then rose again, and the main years of displacement in the data are 2024 and 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals summed over every host country, reported to UNHCR.
